shortDescription: The CAC 40 Index gained 1 points or 0.02 percent on Thursday to close at 8282 points.Gains were led by Capgemini (4.66%), Stellantis NV (4.04%) and Publicis (3.87%).Biggest losers were Hermes International (-3.10%), Essilor (-3.09%) and LVMH (-2.22%).
